reason: The wedding is a few months away and the house has to look right before relatives arrive, and I have no time to chase a local contractor, buy paint and argue about dates. With one fixed price, a paint company's name behind the crew and a finish date agreed before they start, I'd book the site visit and go ahead if the date works.
objection: They say the crew will finish by the agreed date, but nothing says what happens if they don't. If they walk off halfway with the wedding two weeks out, a peeling guarantee is no help to me.
would_change_my_mind: If the site visit can't give me a finish date well before the wedding, or they won't put the date and some compensation for missing it in writing, I'd go back to a contractor I know through relatives.
